postReview.title: Manchester City 5-0 Norwich City: Debutants Samba and Allan lead EFL Cup thrashing
postReview.description: Teenagers Floyd Samba and Ryan McAidoo, as well as recent signing Allan, found the net as Manchester City handily dispatched Norwich City.

postReview.title: Manchester City 5-0 Norwich City: los debutantes Samba y Allan lideran la goleada en la EFL Cup
postReview.description: Los jóvenes Floyd Samba y Ryan McAidoo, junto al reciente fichaje Allan, marcaron en la cómoda goleada del Manchester City ante el Norwich City.

postReview.title: Manchester City 5 x 0 Norwich City: estreantes Samba e Allan comandam goleada na EFL Cup
postReview.description: Os jovens Floyd Samba e Ryan McAidoo, além do recém-contratado Allan, marcaram na tranquila vitória do Manchester City sobre o Norwich City.

postReview.title: Manchester City-Norwich City 5-0: gli esordienti Samba e Allan trascinano il City in EFL Cup
postReview.description: I giovani Floyd Samba e Ryan McAidoo e il nuovo acquisto Allan a segno nel 5-0 del Manchester City sul Norwich City

postReview.title: Manchester City 5:0 Norwich City: Debütanten Samba und Allan führen City zum Kantersieg im EFL Cup
postReview.description: Die Nachwuchsspieler Floyd Samba und Ryan McAidoo sowie Neuzugang Allan trafen beim souveränen Sieg von Manchester City gegen Norwich City.

postReview.title: Manchester City 5-0 Norwich City : Samba et Allan buteurs pour leurs débuts en EFL Cup
postReview.description: Les jeunes Floyd Samba et Ryan McAidoo, ainsi que la recrue Allan, ont marqué lors de la large victoire de Manchester City contre Norwich City.

postReview.title: مانشستر سيتي 5-0 نورويتش سيتي: الوافدان الجديدان سامبا وآلان يقودان اكتساح كأس الرابطة

postReview.description: Os adolescentes Floyd Samba e Ryan McAidoo, além do recente reforço Allan, marcaram na vitória tranquila do Manchester City sobre o Norwich City.

preReview.title: Preview: Man City face Norwich City in Carabao Cup, with Brighton due to face the winners
preReview.description: Manchester City will be looking to continue their perfect start to the season as they host Championship side Norwich City in the third round of the Carabao Cup.

preReview.title: Previa: el Manchester City recibe al Norwich City en la Carabao Cup y el ganador se medirá al Brighton
preReview.description: El Manchester City buscará mantener su pleno de victorias esta temporada ante el Norwich City, de la Championship, en la tercera ronda de la Carabao Cup.

preReview.title: Anteprima: il Man City sfida il Norwich City in Carabao Cup e la vincente affronterà il Brighton
preReview.description: Il Manchester City punta a dare seguito a un avvio di stagione impeccabile ospitando il Norwich City, squadra di Championship, nel terzo turno di Carabao Cup.

preReview.title: Prévia: Manchester City recebe o Norwich City pela Copa da Liga, e vencedor enfrenta o Brighton
preReview.description: O Manchester City tentará manter o início perfeito de temporada ao receber o Norwich City, da segunda divisão, pela terceira fase da Copa da Liga Inglesa.

preReview.title: Vorschau: Man City empfängt Norwich City im Carabao Cup – der Sieger trifft auf Brighton
preReview.description: Manchester City will seinen perfekten Saisonstart fortsetzen, wenn der Championship-Klub Norwich City in der dritten Runde des Carabao Cups zu Gast ist.

preReview.title: Avant-match : Manchester City reçoit Norwich en Carabao Cup, Brighton attend le vainqueur
preReview.description: Manchester City tentera de poursuivre son début de saison parfait lors de la réception de Norwich City, pensionnaire de Championship, au troisième tour de la Carabao Cup.
